scope: Evidence-locked computational results available in the local FORGE repository. This file does not contain prospective synthesis, formulation, or biological outcomes.

claim_classes.Measured: Direct experimental observation in a source or prospective experiment.
claim_classes.Computed: Deterministic or statistical result computed from a hash-pinned local artifact.
claim_classes.Reported: Statement or datum reported by an external source and preserved with provenance.
claim_classes.Inferred: Interpretation supported by evidence but not directly measured or computed as the stated claim.
claim_classes.Proposed: Planned method, threshold, analysis, or experiment without a completed result.

evidence_statuses.verified_frozen: Completed result with a locally verified, hash-pinned artifact.
evidence_statuses.verified_nonselecting: Completed diagnostic or gate whose protocol forbids using it alone to select a model or checkpoint.
evidence_statuses.diagnostic_only: Completed result that is explicitly ineligible for model selection or a headline performance claim.
evidence_statuses.trained_pending_evaluation: Training completed, but the prespecified generation comparison is not yet present.
evidence_statuses.proposed_pending: Not yet completed and not available as evidence.
evidence_statuses.historical_stale: Historically valid record superseded for current operational use by a later artifact.

terminology_locks: R1 is reaction-enumerated support, not route-certified chemistry.
The model-facing graph identity is constitutional and stereochemistry-free; stereochemical provenance is retained separately where available.
Exact Ugi forward enumeration establishes graph and L1 transform consistency, not experimental synthesis, substrate-scope success, L2/L3 closure, or procurement closure.
Structural component novelty and L1 admission do not establish route closure, exact-product synthesis, or experimental success.
A component graph absent from the frozen catalog is assigned missing route knowledge until assessed; catalog absence is not chemical infeasibility.
The supported graph space is bounded by the declared atom, bond, charge, size, branching, and cycle-rank policy.
Morphology-level applicability enrichment is authorized; potency remains terminal ranking only, and synthesis trajectory guidance is not authorized.
The current Ugi program is an AGILE-type amine-aldehyde-isocyanide three-component reaction program.

entries.claim: The model-facing broad lipid corpus contains 15,229 unique constitutional graphs after collapsing 204 duplicate rows from 15,433 source rows.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: After constitutional standardization, the model-facing corpus comprised 15,229 unique lipid graphs derived from 15,433 source rows; 204 duplicate rows were collapsed and 100 mixture measurements were excluded from single-structure weighting.
entries.limitations: 15,433 is a source-row count, not a unique model-graph count. Constitutional identity does not preserve stereochemical distinctions.

entries.claim: Four frozen constitutional split schemes cover all 15,229 graphs with zero groups crossing folds.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: We froze source-study, headgroup, linker/scaffold and component-family partitions before model training, with no group assigned across folds.
entries.limitations: The split schemes answer different questions and their fold sizes should not be compared as model performance.

entries.claim: Exact reconstruction through the frozen reaction registry is partial for held heads, linker/scaffold groups and component families, and zero for full source-study holdout.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: A cross-platform leakage and registry-coverage audit recovered 11.4% of held-head, 17.6% of held-linker/scaffold and 9.1% of held-component-family structures, but no complete source-study holdout structures, exposing the boundary of the frozen reaction registry.
entries.limitations: This is a leakage and reaction-registry coverage audit, not a source-study generalization score for the whole-lipid generator and not evidence that held-out molecules are unsynthesizable.

entries.claim: The reconciled AGILE measurement set contains 1,100 single-structure constitutional graphs with exact HeLa and RAW 264.7 label agreement; 100 mixture measurements are retained as abstentions.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: We reconciled all 1,200 AGILE measurement rows, retaining 1,100 single-compound constitutional graphs and treating 100 mixture measurements as structure-level abstentions; the HeLa and RAW 264.7 values matched the official workbook exactly.
entries.limitations: The 1,200 nominal measurements must not be called 1,200 unique single-molecule graphs.

entries.claim: All 12,276 original virtual Ugi products have one exact decomposition under the frozen Ugi transform into 93 original components.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The frozen Ugi transform produced one exact component decomposition for each of 12,276 original virtual products, spanning 22 amines, 62 aldehydes and 9 isocyanides.
entries.limitations: Algorithmic exactness under the transform is L1 graph consistency, not route closure or proof that each virtual product was experimentally synthesized.

entries.claim: The current Phase 1 Ugi union contains 12,386 unique constitutional products and 95 current components; the broader R1 corpus contains 464,265 reaction-enumerated products.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The current Ugi-L1 union comprised 12,386 unique constitutional products assembled from 95 components; the separate R1 corpus comprised 464,265 reaction-enumerated products.
entries.limitations: R1 is reaction-enumerated support, not route-certified chemistry. The 95-component current union differs from the 93-component original virtual library and the 424-component expanded registry.

entries.claim: A provenance-aware expansion admitted 424 L1-structural components, of which 329 were outside the 95-component current catalog and only one was E2 route-closed.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: We expanded the Ugi component registry from 95 to 424 L1-compatible constitutional structures, including 264 amines, 107 aldehydes and 53 isocyanides; only one expanded component was already closed through the stricter E2 route criterion.
entries.limitations: L1 admission establishes structural handle and forward-context consistency only. It does not establish complete precursor synthesis, exact substrate success, or procurement closure.

entries.claim: Exact forward enumeration of the expanded registry produced 1,486,415 unique constitutional products.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Applying the atom-mapped Ugi transform to the admitted component registry yielded 1,486,415 unique constitutional products, which were partitioned by frozen component-family assignments before training-corpus selection.
entries.limitations: The 1,497,144 Cartesian upper bound and 1,486,415 unique products are different quantities. Enumeration does not imply observed synthesis, L2/L3 closure, biological activity, or model open-endedness.

entries.claim: The production Ugi training corpus contains 112,386 products selected with source-stratified, family-weighted sampling and frozen component-disjoint folds.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: We retained all 12,386 current-union products and selected 100,000 expanded products through deterministic source-stratified, family-weighted sampling, yielding 66,464 training, 15,800 calibration and 30,122 held-out products.
entries.limitations: Uniform product-row sampling is prohibited because repeated component combinations would otherwise dominate the learned distribution.

entries.claim: Automated source adjudication supports dense L1 supervision but sparse, positive-heavy L2 supervision.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Source adjudication retained 44 structure-resolved upstream routes from 45 route instances and no reported experimental route failures, supporting a hybrid evidence-aware L2 system rather than a locally trained success-probability model.
entries.limitations: The source literature is positive-heavy. Absence of a reported failure is not evidence of success, and a source route is not automatically a complete product dossier.

entries.claim: Current L2 supervision supports hierarchical joint product/L1 generation followed by hybrid recursive upstream routing, but not a monolithic complete-route decoder or synthesis-success model.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Dense product-to-Ugi decomposition supervision and sparse upstream-route evidence motivated a hierarchical design: joint product/L1 generation with recursive, evidence-aware L2/L3 completion.
entries.limitations: This architectural decision was frozen before exact-source step execution. The later computational-dossier audit does not change the sparse, role-imbalanced and positive-heavy nature of the L2 corpus, and it is not a prospective synthesis result.

entries.claim: Composing the original 93-component program ledger with current procurement records closes every proposed leaf for 23 of 24 exact-source component programs and all 47 family-projected programs; this yields conservative upstream-leaf coverage for subsets of the original 12,276 products, but not complete forward-verified dossiers.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: When current procurement records were composed with the original component-program ledger, 23 of 24 exact-source programs and all 47 family-projected programs had every proposed leaf procurement-closed. This gave conservative terminal/exact upstream-leaf coverage to 1,734 of 12,276 products and terminal/exact/family-projected coverage to 8,432 products.
entries.limitations: These counts describe proposed-leaf procurement closure and do not by themselves establish step-level forward verification. Exact-source step verification and final L1/L2/L3 composition are recorded in separate later entries; family projections remain non-exact.

entries.claim: Four exact-source-only graph transforms uniquely reconstruct the expected canonical product for every extracted upstream step in the 24 exact-source Ugi component programs.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Exact canonical products were uniquely reconstructed for all 46 extracted upstream reaction steps spanning all 24 exact-source Ugi component programs.
entries.limitations: Qualification is limited to these source-resolved pairs. It does not establish general substrate scope, encode reported reagents or conditions, prove experimental success, apply to family-projected programs or by itself close complete product dossiers.

entries.claim: Fail-closed composition of exact Ugi L1 reconstruction, exact-source L2 step verification and the frozen L3 snapshot yields 1,734 complete computational product dossiers.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Under exact-source route evidence and the frozen procurement snapshot, 1,734 of 12,276 Ugi products have complete forward-consistent computational L1/L2/L3 dossiers.
entries.limitations: A complete computational dossier does not establish that the exact product was synthesized or that synthesis, isolation, purification, formulation or biological testing succeeded. Current procurement closure is time-stamped, and family-projected programs remain explicitly non-exact.

entries.claim: Fail-closed evidence composition across all 424 L1-admitted production components identifies 41 route-complete components and exposes strong role imbalance in the remaining route gaps.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Among 424 L1-admitted production components, 41 were accepted terminals or had exact-source, uniquely forward-verified upstream programs closed to frozen terminal evidence.
entries.limitations: Structural admission, handle qualification, provenance and motif similarity are not route closure. Component-level closure does not prove every Cartesian product assembles, that an exact product was synthesized, or that synthesis, formulation or biological testing succeeded.

entries.claim: The selected graph oracle has modest held-shift performance and universally abstains from generative guidance.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Across the prespecified scaffold and held-component evaluation schemes, the selected role-aware graph ensemble achieved an equal-endpoint post-selection R2 of 0.183; all declared generative guidance domains failed the fixed applicability gates, so the oracle was frozen as a diagnostic with universal abstention.
entries.limitations: Do not report resubstitution metrics as performance. The oracle is a general in-vitro transfection diagnostic, not an in-vivo endpoint oracle, and is not authorized to tilt generation.

entries.claim: The released LANTERN checkpoint reproduces a higher HeLa random-split R2 than the selected FORGE oracle on the same assignments, but the LANTERN pipeline fits feature and target scaling before splitting and is diagnostic-only.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: On LANTERN's persisted random assignments, its released checkpoint reproduced a HeLa test R2 of 0.820 and the selected FORGE oracle reached 0.785 with train-only preprocessing; because the released LANTERN pipeline scales features and labels before splitting, this comparison was retained as a source-reproduction diagnostic and excluded from model selection.
entries.limitations: The performance difference cannot be attributed entirely to leakage because architectures, features and checkpoint-selection procedures also differ. Random splitting does not establish component-family transfer.

entries.claim: Exact component novelty is independent from a frozen four-view chemical applicability definition, and the selected HeLa oracle performs substantially better in the interpolative than extrapolative bin.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Exact component identity was recorded independently from four-view chemical applicability; 153 generated products containing exact-new components remained interpolative under the frozen component-shift definition.
entries.limitations: The pooled bin metrics are descriptive results for an already selected oracle. Applicability thresholds do not use biological outcomes, but being interpolative does not itself authorize guidance.

entries.claim: Fold-specific conditional conformal uncertainty passes the original numerical gates for two interpolative role-shift schemes but remains unsupported across the full precursor-role space.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Conditional uncertainty met the fixed numerical gates for held-head and held-aldehyde--isocyanide-pair interpolative diagnostics, but incomplete role support kept biological guidance in abstention.
entries.limitations: This conditional audit was specified after inspection of the v3 outer-test diagnostic. It does not retroactively create a pristine authorization test, and it cannot support unrestricted potency guidance.

entries.claim: The sparse constitutional representation exactly reconstructs all 15,229 accepted broad-corpus graphs, including all 1,891 aromatic records.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The sparse constitutional encoding reconstructed all 15,229 accepted lipid graphs exactly, including all 1,891 aromatic structures.
entries.limitations: This establishes representational fidelity, not learned generation quality. The early feasibility implementation is superseded for production serialization by the V5 canonical audit.

entries.claim: The production canonical offspring representation is exact and invariant to tested atom permutations across all 15,229 broad-corpus graphs.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: A deterministic sparse offspring program gave exact graph round-trips for all 15,229 structures and identical serializations across 30,458 atom-permuted encodings.
entries.limitations: The canonical root and traversal are serialization devices, not chemical semantics. Broad-corpus maxima differ from the narrower declared Ugi production bounds.

entries.claim: The declared Ugi bounds cover every admitted component, every balanced-corpus product and every product in the expanded exact-forward universe.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The declared Ugi support bounds covered all 424 admitted components, all 112,386 balanced-corpus products and all 1,486,415 products in the expanded exact-forward universe.
entries.limitations: Capacity coverage of an LNPDB hydrophobic proxy is not Ugi compatibility, route evidence, oracle applicability, or synthesis success. The model is general only within these declared bounds.

entries.claim: The full-morphology sparse generator completed 4,750 deterministic L4 training steps; calibration loss selected step 500 as the training checkpoint, but checkpoint generation audits remain nonselecting.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The unguided product-plus-L1 sparse generator completed 4,750 deterministic training steps; the lowest calibration loss occurred at step 500.
entries.limitations: The run used neither route nor biological guidance. Calibration loss is not a generation-validity, novelty, route-closure or biological-performance metric.

entries.claim: A fixed-program 256-sample audit reveals increasing distributional conformity and exact training-corpus reproduction at later checkpoints.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Across a fixed 256-program audit, steps 1,000 and 2,000 produced 99.6% and 99.2% valid products, respectively; the later checkpoint moved closer to the reference descriptor distribution but reproduced more exact frozen products (9 versus 1).
entries.limitations: This fixed-program gate is nonselecting. It does not by itself establish open-ended generation, and step 4,000's higher realism coincides with substantially more exact-corpus reproduction.

entries.claim: At step 1,000, a 512-program held-component probe generated mostly valid, forward-reconstructable products and 429 products containing at least one inverse-reconstructed precursor absent from all 424 admitted components.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: In a 512-program held-component probe at step 1,000, 511 products were valid and exactly forward-reconstructable; 429 of these contained at least one inverse-reconstructed precursor graph absent from the 424-component admitted catalog.
entries.limitations: The probe supplies morphology programs only. Held-role labels are inherited solely for stratification; generated components are recovered from each generated product by deterministic inverse Ugi decomposition. Structural component novelty does not imply route closure, synthesis success, product novelty, biological activity, or checkpoint selection.

entries.claim: At step 2,000, the same 512-program held-component probe generated 506 valid, forward-reconstructable products, with lower novelty and more corpus reproduction than step 1,000.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: At step 2,000, 506 of 512 held-component probe products were valid and exactly forward-reconstructable; 404 contained an inverse-reconstructed precursor absent from the admitted catalog, while exact frozen-product matches increased to 65.
entries.limitations: Three valid products failed the head-handle policy because the inverse-reconstructed head contained three distinct amine sites. As at step 1,000, labels describe probe strata; novelty is computed from actual inverse-reconstructed components.

entries.claim: Step 2,000 has lower fixed-noise held-out loss than step 1,000, but held-out loss is not a generation metric.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Step 2,000 reduced fixed-noise held-out loss relative to step 1,000 on both the complete 30,122-product held-out fold and the fixed 512-program probe.
entries.limitations: Loss evaluates denoising likelihood under a fixed corruption protocol. It must not be described as validity, novelty, route closure, or synthesis performance, and does not override the generation trade-off.

entries.claim: Unconditional sampling from the training-fold program prior corroborates the step-1,000 open-endedness result.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Among 1,024 unconditional step-1,000 samples, 1,009 were valid and exactly forward-reconstructable, and 844 contained at least one inverse-reconstructed precursor absent from the admitted component catalog.
entries.limitations: The morphology programs are sampled from the training-fold prior, but no component identities or product graphs are supplied. This remains an unguided, nonselecting computational gate.

entries.claim: The unconditional step-2,000 sample is more distribution-conforming but less valid and less component-novel than step 1,000.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Among 1,024 unconditional step-2,000 samples, 993 were valid and exactly forward-reconstructable; 793 contained an inverse-reconstructed precursor absent from the catalog, while exact frozen-product matches increased to 100.
entries.limitations: The result corroborates a realism-versus-reproduction trade-off and does not select step 2,000 or authorize route or biological guidance.

entries.claim: The matched size-only arm completed training and was evaluated at all five shared checkpoints under the frozen v3 selection protocol; no size-only checkpoint passed every gate.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: A matched size-only ablation completed 4,750 deterministic training steps and was evaluated at five shared checkpoints under the frozen v3 protocol; no checkpoint passed every prespecified gate.
entries.limitations: Training loss is not comparable across conditioning objectives as a stand-alone architecture decision. The v3 result evaluates product-plus-L1 generation only and does not evaluate route closure or biological or synthesis guidance.

entries.claim: A hash-pinned matched comparison selected the full-morphology step-1,000 checkpoint as the production product-plus-L1 generator because it was the only one of ten architecture-checkpoint candidates to pass every frozen gate.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Under a prespecified matched comparison of ten architecture-checkpoint candidates, the full-morphology step-1,000 model was the only checkpoint to pass every product-plus-L1 gate; 1,007 of 1,024 fresh samples were valid and exactly forward-reconstructable, and 847 attempts contained a component outside the admitted catalog while satisfying all usable open-endedness checks.
entries.limitations: The selector used training and calibration products only and excluded all 30,122 heldout structures. It authorizes unguided product-plus-L1 generation only; L2/L3 routing, synthesis guidance, biological guidance and experimental success were not evaluated.

entries.claim: A nonselecting post-selection audit found no declared-support, forbidden-substructure, inverse-decomposition, exact-forward or handle failure among the selected checkpoint's 1,007 valid products, while identifying 78 low-heteroatom-fraction products for review.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: In a post-selection diagnostic, all 1,007 valid samples remained inside declared support and passed inverse component recovery, exact Ugi reconstruction and handle checks; 78 had a heteroatom fraction below the selection-reference 1st percentile and were retained as review flags.
entries.limitations: Motif and heteroatom flags are candidate-review diagnostics, not automatic synthesis or biological exclusions. The audit cannot alter model selection, evaluates no L2/L3 routes, synthesis value or biological activity, and skipped all heldout products.

entries.claim: A descriptive post-selection stress test on 512 held-family-associated morphology programs produced 511 valid products, all of which passed exact inverse-L1 recovery, component-handle qualification and exact Ugi forward reconstruction.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: In a descriptive post-selection stress test of 512 held-family-associated morphology programs, 511 products were valid and all passed inverse component recovery, handle qualification and exact Ugi forward reconstruction; 429 attempts contained a component outside the 424-component catalog.
entries.limitations: The probe was inspected before checkpoint freeze and is not a pristine heldout estimate. It tests robustness under held-family-associated coarse morphology, not recovery of a requested held component, route closure, synthesis, biology or non-Ugi generalization.

entries.claim: Exact role-specific constitutional identity partitioned the selected sample into original-component, admitted transferred-or-expanded-known, and catalog-absent component strata without treating structural novelty as route closure or infeasibility.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Exact structural provenance partitioned 1,007 reconstructed products into 30 original-only, 130 containing an admitted transferred or expanded known component but no catalog-absent component, and 847 containing a component absent from the frozen 424-component catalog; every catalog-absent occurrence was marked route not assessed because of missing knowledge, not infeasible.
entries.limitations: Exact catalog matching does not establish route closure or experimental success. Catalog absence does not establish product novelty, unsynthesizability or biological novelty. The static route join performed no route planning.

entries.claim: A descriptive post-selection tail audit found strong depletion of ester-bearing and carbon-carbon-unsaturated aldehyde modes and introduced adjacent carbon-branch pairs that were absent from the selection-visible reference.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: In a descriptive post-selection audit, ester-like carbonyls occurred in 19/1,007 generated aldehyde components versus 40,136/82,264 selection-visible references, carbon-carbon double bonds occurred in 0/1,007 versus 27,028/82,264, and adjacent carbon branch pairs occurred in 27/1,007 aldehydes and 63/1,007 isocyanides versus zero in either reference role.
entries.limitations: The audit is nonselecting, excludes heldout component families and assesses graph-derived structural chemotypes only. It does not assess L2/L3 route closure, synthesis feasibility, formulation or biological activity.

entries.claim: A support-preserving morphology proposal more than doubled the probability of generating terminal chemistry inside the frozen multiview AGILE support region while retaining positive probability for all qualified programs.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: On fresh terminal outcomes, morphology-aware allocation increased the supported-product rate from 3.87% to 8.64% while retaining non-zero probability for every qualified morphology program.
entries.limitations: The proposal enriches but does not guarantee terminal applicability. It uses no potency labels and does not authorize potency outside the frozen terminal support region.

entries.claim: A decision-aligned morphology classifier had measurable HeLa signal, but its single frozen nested proposal did not improve unique supported conservative-high-potency terminal yield over applicability allocation plus terminal ranking.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The frozen potency-weighted morphology challenger produced 23 unique supported conservative-high-potency tail-novel products versus 27 under applicability enrichment alone at the same generation and oracle budgets; potency trajectory tilting was not promoted.
entries.limitations: The negative efficiency result does not imply that morphology contains no biological signal. Absolute potency for exact-new components remains prospectively unvalidated.

entries.claim: Graph2Edits expanded route hypotheses and recovered known-family transformations, but proposal confidence alone did not create route evidence.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: The reaction proposal engine generated 173 single-step hypotheses for 30 one-gap components; 27 targets had a graph-consistent hypothesis in an already qualified reaction family, whereas 138 proposal rows remained new-family hypotheses without route evidence.
entries.limitations: A model proposal is a search hypothesis, not experimental evidence, terminal-material closure or a synthesis-success probability.

entries.claim: Evidence-safe route-readiness guidance changed terminal identities but did not improve route-ready product yield relative to complete generation followed by the same route assessment.
entries.safe_manuscript_wording: Matched route-aware resampling produced two route-ready products among 56 unique terminals versus three after ordinary generation and identical complete-product routing; synthesis trajectory guidance was not promoted.
entries.limitations: The null concerns this sparse intermediate controller. Complete-product proposal-augmented L1/L2/L3 route search remains part of candidate selection before prospective panel lock.

pending_results.required_result: Apply the frozen applicability proposal, terminal support policy, conservative potency ranking, diversity policy and proposal-augmented route search to matched candidate pools before locking the prospective panel.
pending_results.safe_current_statement: The production generator and applicability proposal are frozen, but no prospective candidate panel has yet been locked.

pending_results.required_result: Extend the completed original-library dossiers to generated beyond-catalog candidates and the locked prospective panel, with forward verification, evidence grade, availability and uncertainty for every nonterminal branch.
pending_results.safe_current_statement: Complete computational dossiers exist for 1,734 original virtual-library products, but no generated beyond-catalog or locked prospective candidate dossier is yet evidenced.

pending_results.required_result: Run proposal-augmented complete-product routing on an arm-balanced shortlist before panel lock and preserve the disposition of every routed and attempted candidate.
pending_results.safe_current_statement: Mid-trajectory synthesis guidance was tested and not promoted; complete-product route search remains required before prospective panel lock.

pending_results.required_result: Prospectively test an arm-balanced panel selected by the promoted applicability proposal and the identical conservative terminal potency-ranking policy, with measured formulation and biological outcomes.
pending_results.safe_current_statement: Applicability shapes morphology allocation and potency ranks supported terminals, but no prospective potency or delivery claim is yet available.

pending_results.required_result: Lock candidates and report every synthesis attempt through correct product, conversion, isolated yield, purity, route modification, precursor failure, LNP formulation and functional biological outcome.
pending_results.safe_current_statement: No prospective synthesis, formulation or biological result is represented in this evidence matrix.
